packageRules.description: Batch non-major Rust crate updates into one weekly pull request.
Batch non-major mise tool updates into one weekly pull request. The Rust toolchain stays separate because it sets the MSRV.

Renovate reads Java versions from Adoptium's semver field, which encodes a respin such as 17.0.20.1+1 as 17.0.20+101. mise names that release by its OpenJDK version, so the semver form cannot be installed. Allow only releases whose two forms agree.
